info.name: Calendar Bridge
info.summary: Subscribe to external iCal feeds and share them read-only with groups
info.description:
Calendar Bridge lets administrators subscribe to external iCal/WebCal feeds and automatically share them as read-only relay calendars with Nextcloud groups.
Instead of every group member manually adding an external calendar link, an admin configures the feed once. The app fetches it in the background and shares the resulting internal calendar with the selected groups — no action required from end users.
Features: - Subscribe to any public or authenticated iCal/WebCal feed - Automatic background sync (configurable interval, minimum 15 minutes) - Read-only sharing with one or more Nextcloud groups - HTTP ETag/Last-Modified caching to avoid unnecessary transfers - Diff-based sync: only changed events are written - Optional stripping of ATTENDEE/ORGANIZER fields (Privacy by Design) - Admin notifications on persistent fetch failures - Manual sync and connection test from the admin UI
